ranked_methods.reason: Most likely root site because its body contains the exact flexible-array/empty-brace interaction central to the bug. In pop_init_level, flexible array member initialization is specially diagnosed, but empty initialization is explicitly discarded: for zero elements it treats "{ }" as zeroinit, and for flexible arrays it says "Silently discard empty initializations." This is precisely where C23 empty-brace acceptance can accidentally suppress the expected flexible-array diagnostics, while still distinguishing nested contexts via constructor_depth > 2 versus pedwarn_init("initialization of a flexible array member"). It directly implements the semantic policy the bug summary describes.
